New pure module services/gateway/src/domain/session/path.ts (isEncodedBypass: decoded path starts with /api/ or /internal/ but raw path is not canonical, i.e. prefix or an unreserved char is %-encoded). Applied in (a) an onRequest guard registerPathGuard() in http/static/security-headers.ts (registered first in registerAll; runs after the T-00-08 pipeline hook but before any handler, answers 404 GW-NOTFOUND-900), (b) publicAuth (classifies on the decoded path; 404 for non-canonical), (c) guardWebShellRequest (decoded classification, so /%61pi/v1/nope is 404 not SPA index). Same guard for content: wrapped def.register in services/content/src/config.ts (registerGuarded adds the onRequest hook then calls registerAll) because app.ts is frozen; answers 404 CT-NOTFOUND-900 on /%69nternal/... . Root cause (shared-kernel pipeline.ts authenticate()/onRequest use raw req.url) escalated below.

escalations.detail: shared-kernel createFastify: malformed URL percent sequences bypass the pipeline error handler and return Fastify's default {statusCode,error,message} JSON (400), not RFC 9457 problem+json. Candidate CR: set routerOptions.onBadUrl / frameworkErrors in createFastify.

createService shutdown order (waitIdle before hooks) makes SSE shutdown wait the full grace_ms; candidate CR: run onShutdown hooks that end long-lived streams before waitIdle, or let hijacked requests leave in-flight accounting.
IF-GW-001 request body BootstrapTokenRequest{purpose} exists in the contract but the Brief does not mention it; purpose is validated and ignored.

T-00-08 shared-kernel service/pipeline.ts: onRequest and authenticate() classify /api/ and /internal/ by raw req.url while find-my-way decodes %XX before routing, so /%61pi/... and /%69nternal/... skip auth in every service (SEC, NFR-SEC-002/003/019). Fix at the root: choose the auth class from the matched route (req.routeOptions.config.route.path / allowedCallers) or reject non-canonical encodings in the pipeline; also compare caller kind with allowedCallers for /api. Workarounds here: gateway registerPathGuard + publicAuth, content registerGuarded (config.ts); they become redundant once fixed. Other services (learning, ai-gateway, ops) need the same until the root fix lands.
dev proxy HMR upgrade Host check depends on @fastify/http-proxy routing websocket upgrades through fastify preHandler (verified by IT-102).

shared-kernel service/pipeline.ts classifies requests for authentication (authenticate(), cache-control, request-id warn, deadline rule) by the RAW req.url prefix, while find-my-way decodes %XX before routing. /%69nternal/... skips the caller-token check in EVERY service and /%61pi/... skips publicAuth. Requested: authenticate on the decoded or matched route path (req.routeOptions.url / route.path) and enforce caller in route.allowedCallers for /api routes. Gateway and content carry defensive canonical-path onRequest guards until then (UT-GW-112~115, IT-227); other services (learning, ai-gateway, ops-api) need the same pipeline fix or their own guard.
